user.title: Connect Home Assistant MCP
user.description: {detected}. Use the MCP server on THIS Home Assistant instance with the Assist API and Control Home Assistant enabled. The URL is suggested automatically; enter a long-lived access token from your profile. [Set up MCP](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/config_flow/?domain=mcp_server).

engine.title: Connect the local Truss engine
engine.description: Start the Truss engine on Windows, Docker, or Home Assistant OS and wait for 'Truss models are ready'. Enter the engine computer's LAN address, for example http://192.168.1.50:10350, and its pairing token. Choose bundled live transcription or a compatible streaming server. Standard Whisper upload and Ollama chat endpoints are not compatible.

data.stt_url: External STT WebSocket URL (external mode only)

actions.title: Choose devices and execution threshold
actions.description: Use supported entities already exposed to Assist, limit them to selected rooms, or choose individual entities. Room selection applies only in room mode; the individual list applies only in manual mode. Automatic modes refresh each utterance. The scope must contain 1–24 entities; fewer entities reduce latency. Expose devices in Settings > Voice assistants > Expose. Actions may execute during speech, once per utterance.

data.margin: Minimum lead over the next action (0–1)

error.cannot_connect_mcp: Could not discover compatible MCP tools. Check this HA instance's URL, token, Assist API, and Control Home Assistant setting.
error.cannot_connect_engine: Engine unavailable, models not ready, or invalid streaming endpoint. Check app logs, URL, and token.
error.entity_count: The scope must contain 1–24 entities. Choose fewer rooms or use manual selection if it exceeds 24. For automatic modes, expose supported devices to Assist first.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Truss is already configured. Use its Configure button to change settings.

init.title: Configure Truss Live Voice
init.description: Changing settings reconnects Truss and stops active sessions. Use supported entities already exposed to Assist, limit them to selected rooms, or choose individual entities. Room selection applies only in room mode; the individual list applies only in manual mode. Automatic modes refresh each utterance. The scope must contain 1–24 entities; fewer entities reduce latency. Expose devices in Settings > Voice assistants > Expose. Actions may execute during speech, once per utterance.

error.cannot_connect: Could not validate settings. Select 1–24 entities and check the MCP and engine endpoints, tokens, and model readiness.
error.entity_count: The scope must contain 1–24 entities. Choose fewer rooms or use manual selection if it exceeds 24. For automatic modes, expose supported devices to Assist first.
